Private Function Prop(ByVal o As Object, ByVal what As String) As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    v = CallByName(o, what, VbGet)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Prop = "E" & Err.Number Else Prop = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
End Function

Private Function Described(ByVal i As Interior) As String
    Dim s As String, g As Object, st As Object, p As Variant
    For Each p In Array("Pattern", "Color", "ColorIndex", "ThemeColor", "TintAndShade", "PatternColor")
        s = s & " " & p & "=" & Prop(i, CStr(p))
    Next
    On Error Resume Next
    Set g = i.Gradient
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then Described = s & " G=E" & Err.Number: Exit Function
    On Error GoTo 0
    If g Is Nothing Then Described = s & " G=Nothing": Exit Function
    s = s & " G=" & TypeName(g)
    For Each p In Array("Degree", "RectangleLeft", "RectangleRight", "RectangleTop", "RectangleBottom")
        s = s & " " & p & "=" & Prop(g, CStr(p))
    Next
    s = s & " stops=" & g.ColorStops.Count
    For Each st In g.ColorStops
        s = s & " [" & Prop(st, "Position") & " " & Prop(st, "Color") & " " & Prop(st, "ThemeColor") & " " & Prop(st, "TintAndShade") & "]"
    Next
    Described = s
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, i As Interior, st As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set i = ws.Range("A1").Interior
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\linear.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = 90
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
        Set st = i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0)
        st.ThemeColor = xlThemeColorDark1
        st.TintAndShade = 0
        Set st = i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1)
        st.ThemeColor = xlThemeColorAccent1
        st.TintAndShade = 0
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\recorded.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        i.Pattern = xlPatternRectangularGradient
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\rect.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        i.Pattern = xlPatternRectangularGradient
        i.Gradient.RectangleLeft = 0.5
        i.Gradient.RectangleRight = 0.5
        i.Gradient.RectangleTop = 0.5
        i.Gradient.RectangleBottom = 0.5
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0).Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1).Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\rect_centre.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        i.Color = RGB(255, 200, 0)
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\coloured_first.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = 45
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\degree45.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 7
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = 400
    Case 8
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = -90
    Case 9
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = 12.5
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\degree_fraction.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 10
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0.5).Color = RGB(0, 255, 0)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\three.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 11
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1).Color = RGB(0, 0, 255)
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0).Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\reversed.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 12
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\cleared.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 13
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0.3).Color = RGB(1, 2, 3)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\one_stop.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 14
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1.5)
    Case 15
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(-0.1)
    Case 16
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0).Color = RGB(9, 9, 9)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\duplicate.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 17
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(1).Delete
    Case 18
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(2).Position = 0.25
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\moved.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 19
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(1).TintAndShade = 0.5
    Case 20
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(1).ThemeColor = xlThemeColorAccent2
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(1).TintAndShade = -0.25
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\theme_tint.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 21
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Pattern = xlSolid
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\back_solid.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 22
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Color = RGB(10, 20, 30)
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\colour_after.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 23
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.ColorIndex = xlNone
    Case 24
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Interior.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        Set i = ws.Range("A1:B2").Interior
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\area.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 25
        i.Pattern = xlPatternRectangularGradient
        i.Gradient.RectangleLeft = 2
    Case 26
        i.Pattern = xlPatternRectangularGradient
        i.Gradient.Degree = 30
    Case 27
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.RectangleLeft = 0.2
    Case 28
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        ws.Range("A1").Copy ws.Range("C3")
        Set i = ws.Range("C3").Interior
    Case 29
        i.Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(1).Color = RGB(1, 2, 3)
        i.Gradient.ColorStops(2).ThemeColor = 5
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\mixed.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
    Tried = Mid(Described(i), 2)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
